{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script> -- [run.py args...]

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=land_use
#   --account=POLARIS
#   --partition=bdwall
#   --nodes=1
#   --time=30:00:00
#   --mail-user=jauld@anl.gov
#   --mail-type=ALL

#flux: --job-name=land_use
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: --time-limit=30h

# Omitted Slurm option: --account=POLARIS
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=bdwall
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or on different hardware (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm options: --mail-user / --mail-type
# Flux does not provide a universal, built-in email notification directive in batch scripts.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but you will not receive automatic job emails.

set -eu

main() {
    cd /lcrc/project/POLARIS/bebop/SMART_FY22_LAND_USE/PILATES-SRC-JA
    module_load
    setup_venv
    . venv/bin/activate
    python3 ./run.py "$@"
}

setup_venv() {
    python3 -m pip install --user virtualenv
    [ -d venv ] || virtualenv venv
    . venv/bin/activate
    # python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
}

module_load() {
    module load gcc/10.2.0-z53hda3
    module load python/3.8.10-6kl7zkj
    module load singularity/3.6.4

    python3 -m ensurepip --upgrade
}

main "$@"
"
}
